name: Messari
tagline: Crypto market data and research API for assets, metrics, and on-chain intelligence.
description: Messari provides a developer API for cryptocurrency market data, asset profiles, quantitative metrics, news, and research. Developers use it to pull token fundamentals, price/market stats, and project intelligence into apps, dashboards, and agents. Access is typically API-key authenticated against Messari's documented API base URL.

auth.details: API key authentication; exact header/query scheme verified from official docs when available.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Unpaid/Lite/Pro: 200 req/min (non-enterprise-gated endpoints). MessariAI Free: 10 req/day. Marketing may claim ~20 rpm free.

rate_limits: Unpaid/Lite/Pro: 200 req/min; Enterprise: 600 req/min (global). Service-level limits per endpoint. MessariAI Free: 10/day; Enterprise AI: 600/min.
use_cases: get crypto asset profile and market metrics by symbol
list top assets by market cap for a dashboard
pull historical price or metric time series for a token
fetch crypto news headlines for market monitoring
